export_host_spec.title: NFS Export Host Specification
export_host_spec.description: The host or network specification in /etc/exports that defines which clients may mount the share (e.g., '*', '0.0.0.0/0', '192.168.1.0/24', 'trusted.host.example.com')

nfs_security_flavors.title: NFS Security Flavors in Use
nfs_security_flavors.description: List of security/authentication flavors configured for NFS exports (e.g., sys, krb5, krb5i, krb5p). AUTH_SYS (sys) provides no cryptographic verification.

nfs_version.title: NFS Protocol Version
nfs_version.description: The NFS protocol version in use. NFSv4 is required for native Kerberos support; NFSv3 and earlier do not support Kerberos natively.

kerberos_realm_configured.title: Kerberos Realm Configured
kerberos_realm_configured.description: Indicates whether a Kerberos realm is configured on the NFS server host, a prerequisite for enforcing krb5 security flavors.

no_root_squash_enabled.title: no_root_squash Option Enabled
no_root_squash_enabled.description: Indicates whether any NFS export is configured with 'no_root_squash', allowing remote root users to act as root on the server.

root_squash_explicitly_set.title: root_squash Explicitly Configured
root_squash_explicitly_set.description: Indicates whether 'root_squash' is explicitly set on all NFS exports. When absent, the NFS server may apply a weak default depending on the implementation.

rpcsec_gss_krb5p_enabled.title: RPCSEC_GSS Kerberos Privacy (krb5p) Enabled
rpcsec_gss_krb5p_enabled.description: Whether NFSv4 exports require RPCSEC_GSS with krb5p (providing both authentication and encryption of data in transit). False if sec=sys or sec=krb5/krb5i is used without krb5p.

tunnel_encryption_in_use.title: Tunnel-Based Encryption in Use
tunnel_encryption_in_use.description: Whether NFS traffic is tunneled through an encrypting transport such as VPN (IPsec, WireGuard) or stunnel, compensating for lack of native NFS encryption.

export_access_mode.title: Export Access Mode
export_access_mode.description: The access mode configured for the NFS export, indicating whether clients are granted read-write or read-only access.

export_path_is_sensitive.title: Export Path Contains Sensitive Data
export_path_is_sensitive.description: Indicates whether the exported filesystem path contains sensitive data such as configuration files, credentials, home directories, system directories, or application secrets.

client_scope.title: Client Access Scope
client_scope.description: The scope of clients permitted to mount the export, indicating how broadly access is granted.

nfs_bound_interfaces.title: NFS Bound Network Interfaces
nfs_bound_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces or IP addresses that the NFS daemon and associated RPC services (rpcbind, mountd, statd) are bound to. Use '0.0.0.0' or '*' to indicate all interfaces.

public_interface_exposure_confirmed.title: Public Interface Exposure Confirmed
public_interface_exposure_confirmed.description: Whether the NFS or RPC services are confirmed to be listening on a public-facing or untrusted network interface (e.g., interface with a publicly routable IP address, or bound to 0.0.0.0 without firewall restriction).

firewall_restricts_nfs_ports.title: Firewall Restricts NFS Ports from Untrusted Networks
firewall_restricts_nfs_ports.description: Whether host-level or network firewall rules restrict access to NFS-related ports (TCP/UDP 2049, 111, 20048, and dynamic RPC ports) from untrusted or public network sources.

nfs_software_has_known_cve.title: NFS Software Has Known CVE
nfs_software_has_known_cve.description: Indicates whether the installed NFS server software (kernel NFS module, nfs-utils, or rpcbind) has one or more known CVEs documented in public vulnerability databases.

days_since_last_nfs_package_update.title: Days Since Last NFS Package Update
days_since_last_nfs_package_update.description: Number of days elapsed since any NFS-related package (nfs-utils, nfs-kernel-server, rpcbind) was last updated on the host.

nfs_service_is_running.title: NFS Service Is Currently Running
nfs_service_is_running.description: Indicates whether at least one NFS server service (nfsd, rpcbind, mountd) is actively running and exposed on the host.

nosuid_enforced.title: nosuid Option Enforced
nosuid_enforced.description: Whether the nosuid mount option is present in the client-side NFS mount configuration, preventing setuid/setgid bits on mounted files from taking effect.

noexec_enforced.title: noexec Option Enforced
noexec_enforced.description: Whether the noexec mount option is present in the client-side NFS mount configuration, preventing execution of binaries on the mounted share.

dev_allowed.title: Device Files Allowed (dev)
dev_allowed.description: Whether the 'dev' mount option is active (i.e., 'nodev' is absent), allowing device files on the NFS share to be interpreted as real devices on the client.

rpcbind_listening_interfaces.title: rpcbind Listening Interfaces
rpcbind_listening_interfaces.description: Network interfaces on which the rpcbind/portmapper service is actively listening (e.g., '0.0.0.0', '192.168.1.10', '127.0.0.1')

rpcbind_tcp_wrappers_configured.title: rpcbind TCP Wrappers Restrictions Configured
rpcbind_tcp_wrappers_configured.description: Whether TCP wrappers (/etc/hosts.allow and /etc/hosts.deny) are configured to restrict access to rpcbind from untrusted hosts.

nfsv3_enabled.title: NFSv3 Enabled
nfsv3_enabled.description: Whether NFSv3 protocol support is enabled on the NFS server, making rpcbind exposure operationally significant and preventing exclusive use of the more secure NFSv4.

nfs_mount_event_logging_enabled.title: NFS Mount Event Logging Enabled
nfs_mount_event_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether the NFS server is configured to log mount events, such as via rpcdebug flags or equivalent server-side logging mechanisms.

auditd_nfs_syscall_rules_configured.title: Auditd NFS Syscall Rules Configured
auditd_nfs_syscall_rules_configured.description: Indicates whether auditd rules covering NFS-related system calls (e.g., mount, open, read, write on NFS paths) are present in /etc/audit/rules.d/ or /etc/audit/audit.rules.

nfs_access_attempt_logging_enabled.title: NFS Access Attempt Logging Enabled
nfs_access_attempt_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether the NFS server logs individual file access and export request events, such as via nfsd debug flags or a syslog/journald integration that captures NFS daemon access events.

all_squash_enabled.title: all_squash Option Enabled
all_squash_enabled.description: Whether the NFS export is configured with the 'all_squash' option, which maps all client UIDs/GIDs to the anonymous user.

anon_uid.title: Anonymous UID Mapping
anon_uid.description: The UID to which all client connections are mapped when all_squash is active. A value of 0 maps all clients to root.

anon_gid.title: Anonymous GID Mapping
anon_gid.description: The GID to which all client connections are mapped when all_squash is active. A value of 0 maps all clients to the root group.

nfsv2_enabled.title: NFSv2 Enabled
nfsv2_enabled.description: Indicates whether NFSv2 protocol support is enabled on the NFS server.

nfsv4_enabled.title: NFSv4 Enabled
nfsv4_enabled.description: Indicates whether NFSv4 protocol support is enabled on the NFS server, which is the preferred secure version.

nfsv4_domain_configured.title: NFSv4 Domain Configured
nfsv4_domain_configured.description: Whether a valid NFSv4 domain is explicitly set in /etc/idmapd.conf (Domain= parameter is present and non-empty).

idmapd_service_running.title: idmapd Service Running
idmapd_service_running.description: Whether the rpc.idmapd (or nfs-idmapd) service is active and running on the system.

is_dedicated_mount_point.title: Export Is a Dedicated Mount Point
is_dedicated_mount_point.description: Whether the exported directory is a separate filesystem mount point (i.e., appears as a distinct entry in /proc/mounts or mount output), ensuring clients cannot traverse beyond the export boundary.

fsid_option_configured.title: fsid= Option Configured on Export
fsid_option_configured.description: Whether the NFS export entry includes an explicit 'fsid=' option, which establishes a stable filesystem boundary identity and prevents directory traversal beyond the export scope.

crossmnt_option_configured.title: crossmnt Option Configured on Export
crossmnt_option_configured.description: Whether the NFS export entry includes the 'crossmnt' option, which explicitly allows clients to cross mount point boundaries from the exported directory, further expanding the traversal risk when filesystem isolation is absent.
